description: Deterministic invoice reconciliation policy for the Invoice Exception case study. Synthetic rules, not a real company's financial policy. Human-readable source: docs/BUSINESS_RULES.md.

normalization.identifier_note: Applies to registration_id, document number, purchase order reference and SKU. Separators and leading zeros are kept.
name: trim
collapse_whitespace
casefold
normalization.name_note: Applies to legal names, aliases and line descriptions.

rules: any check with status=fail and severity=blocked -> blocked
else any check with status=unknown -> needs_information
else any check with status=fail and severity=needs_review -> needs_review
decision.duplicate: no assessment and no decision; result references the original

unknown_semantics.root: missing input fact; depends_on=null; produces exactly one question with the check's required_fact and target_object_ids=[object_id]
unknown_semantics.dependent: cannot be evaluated because another check is unresolved; depends_on=<that check code>; produces no question

resolution.supplier: Document supplier.registration_id (normalized) looked up in suppliers; names and aliases are never used for suppliers.
resolution.buyer: Document buyer.registration_id (normalized) looked up in buyers; if registration_id is null, the normalized legal_name must equal legal_name or an explicit alias of exactly one buyer.
resolution.order_dependent_checks_with_proposal: When ORDER_MATCH or LINE_MATCH rests on an unconfirmed agent proposal, dependent checks are evaluated against the proposed order and lines.

outcomes.when: business key found and normalized facts equal
business key found and normalized facts differ
registration_id is null and name resolution fails
registration_id present but not found in buyers
purchase_order_reference present and exactly matches an order reference among all orders
no reference; supplier resolved; exactly one open order of that supplier (and buyer, if resolved) where every document line matches deterministically
no reference; zero or several candidate orders

notes: Outcomes are evaluated top to bottom; the first match wins. A deterministic match always takes precedence over proposals.
A proposal that names a different order than a deterministic match is rejected with VALIDATION_ERROR at registration.

outcomes.when: exactly one order line matches by normalized SKU, explicit alias or description, not taken by another document line
unconfirmed agent proposal covers this line

units_differ.note: QTY_RECEIVED, QTY_ORDER_REMAINING and UNIT_PRICE become not_applicable for this line

notes: An agent-proposed line with a unit mismatch is still fail needs_review; dependent checks become not_applicable.
A proposal that maps a line differently from its deterministic match is rejected with VALIDATION_ERROR.

formula: pass iff calculated_net == declared_net_amount and (declared_tax_amount is null or calculated_tax == declared_tax_amount)
notes: Uses the document's own price and tax rate; tax rate applicability is not checked.

formula: pass iff all three equal declared_subtotal, declared_tax_total, declared_total

outcomes.when: normalized IBAN not in approved_bank_accounts of the resolved document supplier

check_instances.object_id: document checks use document_id; line checks use document line_id
check_instances.count: every non-duplicate result contains exactly 7 document checks + 5 checks per document line

quantities.received: sum(accepted_quantity) of receipts with order_line_id = order line and status = accepted
quantities.previously_invoiced: sum(quantity) of invoice_history lines with status = counted, matched_order_id = order, order_line_id = order line, excluding documents with the current business key
quantities.null_when: order or line not resolved; received and available_to_invoice are also null when goods_receipts.availability = unavailable

search_in: documents imported earlier in the same case
compared_facts: lines as multiset of (sku, quantity, unit, unit_net_price, tax_rate, declared_net_amount, declared_tax_amount)

proposals_and_confirmations.confirmation_channel: human interface only; MCP exposes no confirmation operation
proposals_and_confirmations.effect: new input_revision and a new assessment; previous assessments are kept

required_facts.supplier.registration_id: Supplier registration ID is missing from the document.
required_facts.buyer.registration_id: Buyer registration ID is missing and the buyer name does not resolve to exactly one buyer.
required_facts.order_reference: The purchase order cannot be determined: reference missing or unknown, and no unique deterministic candidate.
required_facts.line_match: A document line cannot be matched to exactly one line of the order.
required_facts.bank_account: Bank account is missing from the document.
